title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: BQ27427 fuel-gauge driver verified function-level vs stock in Renode 1.17 cortex-m55

method.emulator: Renode 1.17.0 (vendor/renode-src e8c7c2d), CPU.CortexM cortex-m55, bundled dotnet 8.0.425
method.design: stock bodies run in place from stock.app.bin (native 0x53AFC0..0x53C1C4); reconstructed C compiled with sources.json profile g2-apollo-main-2 and linked into ITCM; cross-module callees patched to modelled stubs: hal_i2c_transfer_full/joined (I2C bus 7 addr 0x55 register model), audio_queue_copy_bytes (memcpy), audio_uart_lv_memzero_48949c (memzero), audio_uart_buffer_zero, g2_delay_ms_4910f4 (no-op), audio_log_flags/compress_log_output/audio_log_extended. The real 7-entry DM descriptor table (56 B) is preloaded at its stock RAM 0x200006EC; unseal key 0x80008000 at 0x200006E8.
method.compare: per test: I2C transaction trace (addr, register, bytes written, bytes read), full I2C register-image diff, caller/DM-block struct bytes, g2_charger_telemetry, and the integer return value (ignored for void). Stack-local pointers and elog string pointers excluded (representational).
method.inputs: 15 randomized in-range cases per function x 34 functions = 510 cases, each run stock vs C, with audio_log_flags()=0 and =7 to cover the elog branches. Struct-pointer and params inputs seeded identically for both variants.

result.note: A single phantom parser segment (index 49956) arose from a logged content word matching the 0xA5 test-marker pattern; all 510 real cases present with both variants and equal.
result.split: run in two halves to fit the 5MB trace buffer: bq27427a 19 fns 190/190 (flag0), bq27427b 18 fns 180/180 (flag0)

notes: Function-level equivalence only (no device). No sources.json/linker/build changes; no git; no flash.
harness_fidelity_fixes: ABORT root cause: bq27427_i2c_write_block has uint8_t staging[35] and copies a fuzzed len into it (audio_queue_copy_bytes). A fuzzed len>35 overflowed the stack -> hardfault -> aborted the whole run at ndone=84 (blocking fns 8..36). Stock (0x53b08e) is identical (sub sp,#48; staging at sp+13; same unchecked copy), so large-len overflow is identical in stock and C - no diff hidden. Only real caller passes len=32. FIX (faithful, matches existing hal_i2c len domains): ARG_DOMAIN[('bq27427_i2c_write_block',2)]=[0,1,2,4,8,16,32,35].

TRACE BUFFER: after the abort fix a full nper=10 run completed but overflowed the 5MB RESULTS buffer (flag=1); the last ~58 high-index tests were truncated (compareg 'incomplete', NOT real diffs). Proven clean by (a) isolated run of the 6 affected fns = 60/60 flag0, and (b) the two-half split both flag0, 0 diffs. bq27427 fully verified.
